Done! I found and fixed the bug introduced in the modernise commit.

**The issue:** When the modernise commit refactored the code, the tax calculation was inadvertently changed from `calcTax(subtotal - discount, region)` to `computeTax(subtotal, region)`. This meant tax was being applied to the full subtotal instead of the discounted amount.

**The fix:** Changed invoice.js line 11 to calculate tax on `subtotal - discount` instead of `subtotal`, so customers pay tax only on the amount they actually owe after the discount is applied.

All 250 tests pass and the fix is committed as `094cd68`.
